EXAM TRAP   Precision is not accuracy
A simulation reporting a fifth percentile to the nearest pound looks precise, and is only as accurate as the ranges it was given. A question offering a very exact figure from very rough assumptions is testing whether the candidate notices.

EXAM TRAP   Exam view
The calculation is always outcome times probability, summed. The trap is the unweighted average. Where a question asks what simulation adds over expected value, the answer is the distribution, not a better single number.
